office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, protection orders, small claims and civil cases up to $100,000 in Whitman County.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge John Hart, on the bench since his 2018 election, is the only candidate and submitted no statement.

candidates.summary: Whitman County District Court judge since 2018; previously a public defender for about 15 years and Colfax Municipal Court judge. Unopposed in 2022 and again on this ballot; submitted no statement.
highlights: District Court judge since December 2018, after defeating Rob Rembert for an open seat [S4]
About 15 years as a public defender and Colfax Municipal Court judge before the bench [S4]
Received the 2024 Presidential Award of the District and Municipal Court Judges' Association; Washington Judicial College dean in 2023 [S5]
